description: Search the WebSupergoo documentation and web site. Returns the best-matching sections, each with where it is in the documentation, its id, URL and a snippet. Snippets are partial: fetch the sections that look relevant before deciding they don't answer; contents shows the pages around one. Short queries work best - two to four key words, or the API name if you can guess it. Set product for technical questions. If the results miss, search again with fewer words, or with the name the documentation would use (a class, method or property). For a class or member you already know, lookup_api is quicker.

code.description: Only sections that are sample code - when you want an example to adapt.

product.description: The product the question is about: abcpdf, imageglue, wordglue or abcocr. Set it for technical questions; tell it from the user's code (WebSupergoo.ABCpdf* namespaces or Doc objects: abcpdf), and if unsure, use abcpdf. It leaves out pages for other products and general pages about purchasing, licensing and the company - so leave it out for those questions.

query.description: A few key words for what the user wants ("watermark behind content", "split pages"), or a line of their code (doc.HtmlOptions.Engine = EngineType.Chrome). A whole question works too, but extra words can push the right page down.

type.description: Only this content type (an id from list_products: docs, purchasing, support...). Usually left out.

name: search
title: Search the documentation
